strokeOrder: draw the upper horizontal from left to right
lift and descend through the crossing stem, curving left at the foot
lift and draw the short right horizontal from left to right
lift and descend into the lower-right bowl, then sweep right along its base
strokeOrderNote: Sirgazil's 31-frame animation writes four separate pen-down runs: upper horizontal, falling stem, short right horizontal, then lower bowl.

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sirgazil, Hiragana た stroke order animation.gif, hiragana た, 31 frames, 3.1 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 1 October 2009)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The CC0 animation draws た in four pen-down runs with three lifts: the upper horizontal, crossing left-falling stem, short right horizontal, and lower-right bowl. The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans JP subset; handwritten stem curvature and bowl width vary, but the four-run order remains the same.

notes: The ta of たべます; one mora, pronounced as a short, even beat.
